title: Morocco vs France QF is SET — the 2022 rematch

scenes.voiceover: Dark horse number one: Morocco. The 2022 semifinalists are doing it again — Ounahi ran the game today, Hakimi is the best right back in the tournament, and they've conceded once in five matches.
But tonight, the wall moved. Their quarterfinal is France — July ninth, Boston. A rematch of the 2022 semifinal France won. Beat them, and Morocco are ONE game from the final four.

So who's got the easiest path? Honestly — Morocco. Two wins from the semifinal, the only dark horse who's actually lived this stage before... but one of those two wins has to be France. Easiest path in this bracket just means hardest dream with the fewest steps.
Morocco-France, July ninth. If the Atlas Lions do it again, you'll want the full breakdown the second it ends — subscribe, and drop your dark horse in the comments.

title: Every dark horse path runs through a giant

scenes.voiceover: Dark horse number two: Colombia. The quietest machine in the bracket. They held Ghana to ZERO shots on target — nobody else has done that to anyone this tournament.
Their next game is Switzerland — winnable. But win it, and the quarterfinal is almost certainly Messi's Argentina in Kansas City. The machine meets the GOAT.

And here's the pattern nobody's saying out loud: every bottom-half dark horse path runs through Argentina. The top half? It runs through France, then the Portugal-Spain winner. There are no free rides left.
